# Siraa Health — Pediatric Clinic, Gurgaon
> Siraa Health is a pediatric neurodevelopment and child health clinic in Sector 67, Gurgaon, offering evidence-based care for children from birth to 16 years.

## Services
- Pediatric consultation (sick child, same-day appointments)
- Child vaccination (IAP schedule, painless options)
- Newborn care
- Speech and language therapy
- Developmental assessment
- Behaviour therapy
- Autism assessment
- Growth and nutrition
- Allergy and asthma care
- School health checkups
